Thanks again for your interest in Redwood Inference. We're running a small group demo next week that will walk through: model serving basics, Dedicated vs Hosted routing, and a brief Q&A focused on productionizing inference. I've attached a short agenda.

A couple of operational notes we want to confirm with you before we send calendar invites:
- We run tightly-timed cohort sessions (35 min demo + 10–15 min optional follow-on) to keep things actionable for multiple teams.
- We maintain a short waitlist and a standby buffer to avoid long start delays — if a session reaches capacity we'll add folks to the waitlist and fill openings 10 minutes before start.
- If a live deep-dive is needed we can schedule a follow-up with your engineers (1:1).

Please reply with which of these windows works for you (all times ET):
- Tuesday 24 Jun, 10:00–10:45

If none work, drop your availability and we'll add you to the waitlist and offer the next open slot.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Mina / Karthik —

Quick internal proposal on logistics based on the roster flow we've been testing:
- Session length: 35 minutes demo + 15 minutes post-session follow-up window for folks who want 1:1 deep dives. Keeps total meeting slot < 60m.
- Capacity: cap each cohort at 6 prospect orgs (keeps Q&A manageable).
- Buffer: hold a 15-minute standby buffer after each session in case of spillover, and open waitlist slots that auto-promote 10 minutes prior.
- Waitlist policy: we ask for a single contact email and auto-email the next person 10/5/1 minutes before start; if they don't accept we move on.

Propose we publish two recurring windows for next two weeks (10:00 ET and 16:00 ET). I'll update the scheduling roster (link below) and set capacity.

Scheduling roster (edit): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1scheduling_roster

If that works I'll push the calendar invites and include an intake question asking what environment they plan to run on (hosted/dedicated/private).
